context: A uni student checks in on a teen friend after exams
purpose: Teach: いっそう/気が付い/解ら/みえ/陽気/続々/絶えず/浮上

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 試験どうだった？最近いっそう冷えるから、体調心配でさ。
lines.en: How were the exams? It's gotten even colder lately, so I was worried about your health.
lines.style: Warm, slightly older brother tone with casual concern

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがと！でも数学が全然解らなくて、終わってから放心してた。
lines.en: Thanks! But I totally couldn't get the math, so I was dazed after.
lines.style: Teen casual, slightly dramatic and drawn-out vowels

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あー、わかる。気が付いたら時間切れって、あるあるだよね。
lines.en: Ah, I get it. Suddenly realizing time's up — that happens all the time.
lines.style: Sympathetic conversational university student tone, easygoing

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それ！難しい問題が続々出てきて、もう絶えず焦ってた感じ。
lines.en: Right?! Hard questions kept coming one after another, I was constantly panicking.
lines.style: Animated teen complaining, expressive and lively delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも今日は陽気だし、もう変な不安は浮上しないでしょ。
lines.en: But the weather's cheerful today, no more weird worries should pop up.
lines.style: Encouraging gentle upperclassman reassurance, light tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 確かに、窓からみえる桜きれいだし、元気出てきたかも。
lines.en: True, the cherry blossoms visible from the window are pretty, I feel better.
lines.style: Softening teen voice, gradually regaining brightness and energy

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ打ち上げにラーメン行こうよ。奢るから遠慮しないで。
lines.en: Then let's go grab ramen to celebrate. My treat, so don't hold back.
lines.style: Friendly invitation from easygoing university senior, warm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった！レン先輩優しすぎ！全部忘れて満喫するね！
lines.en: Yay! Ren-senpai, you're too kind! I'm gonna forget everything and enjoy it!
lines.style: Bright energetic teen excitement, grateful and bouncy delivery
